description: This file defines models and functions related to RetinaNet object detection architecture using Keras with TensorFlow backend. It includes creating classification and regression submodels, building Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN), and assembling the full RetinaNet model with optional bounding box layers.

methods.name: default_classification_model( num_classes, num_anchors, pyramid_feature_size=256, prior_probability=0.01, classification_feature_size=256, name='classification_submodel' )
methods.description: Creates the default classification submodel for RetinaNet, predicting class scores for each anchor.

methods.name: default_regression_model(num_values, num_anchors, pyramid_feature_size=256, regression_feature_size=256, name='regression_submodel')
methods.description: Creates the default regression submodel for RetinaNet, predicting bounding box offsets for each anchor.

methods.name: __create_pyramid_features(backbone_layers, pyramid_levels, feature_size=256)
methods.description: Builds feature pyramid layers on top of backbone features for use in the detection head.

methods.name: default_submodels(num_classes, num_anchors)
methods.description: Returns default regression and classification submodels for RetinaNet.

methods.name: retinanet( inputs, backbone_layers, num_classes, num_anchors = None, create_pyramid_features = __create_pyramid_features, pyramid_levels = None, submodels = None, name = 'retinanet' )
methods.description: Constructs the full RetinaNet model combining backbone features with FPN, classification, and regression submodels.

methods.name: retinanet_bbox( model = None, nms = True, class_specific_filter = True, name = 'retinanet-bbox', anchor_params = None, pyramid_levels = None, nms_threshold = 0.5, score_threshold = 0.05, max_detections = 300, parallel_iterations = 32, **kwargs )
methods.description: Builds a RetinaNet model with bounding box regression and NMS, returning final detections.
